schemaNote: Reusable regional country-directory data model for GPIR. Each entry represents one country's presence in the Country Intelligence architecture. 'status' drives whether a directory entry is clickable: active = a real, published Country Intelligence page exists; coming_soon = the country is on the GPIR roadmap but no page is published yet. This same shape is intended to be reused for future regions (LATAM, Africa, Europe, Americas, Middle East/GCC) rather than rebuilt per region.
